apps.name: JetGlass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass plane spotter
apps.localizedDescription: JetPhotos + FlightRadar24 in a liquid-glass iOS 26 app. Live map with airline labels and ICAO airport search, photo search and downloads via jetapi.dev.
apps.versionDescription: Plane photos now resolve the aircraft registration (adsbdb.com) before searching jetapi.dev, so photos actually show. Info card displays registration, airspeed and current altitude, with a compact landscape layout. Photos search uses the registration instead of the flight number.
